visualFinding: The raw generated WebGL loader drew Dream Land's tree in front of P1 and omitted the native foreground water. A fail-closed reversed-depth binding and clear correction restored native foreground/background ordering, both fighters, the tree face, left platform and water in the versioned static release. This is a rendering/presentation correction; game camera values and projection were not modified.

imageBenchmark.configuration: unmodified packaged defaults plus QA probe, no experimental cosmetic cuts

separateMinimalTunedLeg.configuration: model detail low, black background, integer FIFO, single prefix, guarded block merging, animation/display-list specialization, animation conditional fusion, lean dispatch and register allocation
separateMinimalTunedLeg.interpretation: A separate cold browser leg, not an A/B control; lower absolute FPS does not identify which optional flag changed performance. The larger all-knobs cold run timed out at scene transition and yielded no FPS sample.

measurementLimit: Single corrected browser leg; this is no causal FPS comparison against the old loader. Native and browser images are separate idle frames with the same reported camera and fighter spawn state; screenshots and isolated development disc are not in the repository. Raw-loader FPS was invalid as evidence of visually normal gameplay. Other stages, roster combinations, and measured input-to-photon latency remain untested on the corrected static package.
